name: finch-delivery
description: Track and browse deliverables (Markdown, Word, PPT, PDF, Excel, web pages, images) produced by the AI assistant across all sessions.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx @finchtoys/minitools doctor .

finch.name: Artifacts
finch.description: Track and browse artifacts produced by the AI — Markdown, Word, PPT, PDF, Excel, web pages, and images.
finch.systemPrompt: When you produce a finished document-type deliverable for the user (Markdown, Word, PowerPoint, PDF, Excel, web page, or image file), call record_artifact with action 'record' to log it. Never record source code, config, or project files (.ts, .js, .py, .go, .rs, .java, .c, .cpp, .sh, .css, .json, .yaml, package.json, etc) — this tracker is only for finished documents the user reads or shares, not implementation files. For Markdown files, include a textPreview of the first ~500 characters.

library.description: Library icon (appPanel, appView, and delivery row icon)

appView.description: Browse every artifact produced by the AI across all sessions.
